/*selectSellerMpStClosingBuyerPopList*/
SELECT X.BUYER , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = X.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , X.ITEM_AMT FROM ( SELECT /*+USE_NL(C A)*/ A.BUYER , SUM(A.AGENT_ITEM_AMT) AS ITEM_AMT FROM ICOMGRDT A /* 구매사별 입고정보 */ , ICOMPODT C /* 발주 제품정보 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND C.CMS_CATLG_ID IN (SELECT /*+(WMSSTCK SYS_C0053026)*/ STDCATLG_ID FROM WMSSTCK WHERE AGENT = '${st_com_code}' AND PROCESS_TYPE = '3') AND A.GR_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}' /*AND A.AGENT = 'KRKORE0069'*/ AND C.PROCESS_TYPE = '3' AND A.STATUS <> 'D' GROUP BY A.BUYER ) X
